inputs.payload: In settings.ini, change only the network retries setting from retries = 3 to retries = 5. Preserve every other byte, including the existing line endings and the final newline. Inspect the original bytes before editing. After editing, use Python to compare the actual file bytes against the original bytes with just that one replacement, print repr() of the resulting bytes and the comparison result, and report what actually happened. You may correct any accidental formatting change before finishing. Do not modify any other project file.
